_about: MedLink screens for the AI assistant. The assistant returns a screen key in suggested_actions; the web/mobile app maps it to its own route. Web routes and mobile tabs are placeholders: the frontend and mobile teams should replace them with the real routes.

common.landing.title: Landing Page
common.landing.description: Hero message, quick search, AI assistant preview, six service shortcuts and the steps Search, Book, Get Care.

common.signup.title: Create Account
common.signup.description: Choose Patient / User or Provider; name, email, Egyptian phone, password, or Continue with Google.

common.verify_email.title: Verify Email
common.verify_email.description: Open the link sent to the email; resend or change the address.

common.login.title: Log In
common.login.description: Email and password, remember me, forgot password, Google sign-in.

common.forgot_password.title: Forgot Password
common.forgot_password.description: Send a password reset link to the email.

common.notifications.title: Notifications
common.notifications.description: Booking updates, reminders and verification results.

patient.home.title: Patient Home
patient.home.description: Greeting, search bar with AI Assistant switch, service shortcuts, recommended providers and next appointment.

patient.search.title: Search Providers
patient.search.description: Search by specialty, provider type, area or name with filters.

patient.nearby_map.title: Nearby Providers (Map)
patient.nearby_map.description: Nearest verified providers on Google Maps sorted by distance.

patient.ai_search.title: AI Search
patient.ai_search.description: Type or speak symptoms; the AI suggests a specialty and shows matching verified providers.

patient.ai_assistant.title: AI Health Assistant (Chat)
patient.ai_assistant.description: Chat about symptoms and MedLink help (next phase).

patient.provider_profile.title: Provider Profile
patient.provider_profile.description: Verified badge, services with fees, locations, working hours, free slots and reviews.

patient.book_appointment.title: Book Appointment
patient.book_appointment.description: Choose service, day and free slot, add notes, confirm.

patient.appointments.title: My Appointments
patient.appointments.description: Upcoming, past and cancelled bookings; view, cancel, reschedule, rate after a completed visit.

patient.review_provider.title: Rate & Review
patient.review_provider.description: Star rating and comment for a completed visit.

patient.medical_history.title: Medical History
patient.medical_history.description: Timeline of visits, doctor notes, lab results and imaging; upload or share files.

patient.profile.title: My Profile
patient.profile.description: Personal details, password and health profile.

provider.signup.title: Provider Sign Up (Step 1 of 3)
provider.signup.description: Name, 14-digit national ID, email, phone, password or Google.

provider.verification.title: Provider Verification (Step 2 of 3)
provider.verification.description: Service type, service name, location, phone, postal code, tax number, medical license (PDF/JPG/PNG, 10 MB), Submit for Review.

provider.under_review.title: Request Under Review (Step 3 of 3)
provider.under_review.description: Waiting for admin approval (up to 48 hours); result by email.

provider.dashboard.title: Provider Dashboard
provider.dashboard.description: Overview of bookings, ratings and activity.

provider.bookings.title: My Bookings (Provider)
provider.bookings.description: Today, next 7 days, pending and cancelled; accept or cancel one or many; reschedule; mark visit outcome.

provider.schedule.title: Weekly Time Slots
provider.schedule.description: Set working days, hours and days off.

provider.services.title: Services & Prices
provider.services.description: Add services from the MedLink list with price in EGP; activate or deactivate.

provider.locations.title: Branch Locations
provider.locations.description: Branch name, address, postal code, phone and map position.

provider.add_medical_record.title: Add Medical History
provider.add_medical_record.description: Title, diagnosis and description required; notes optional.

admin.provider_requests.title: Provider Requests
admin.provider_requests.description: Pending provider applications; view license; accept or reject with reason.

admin.users.title: Manage Users
admin.users.description: Activate or deactivate patient and provider accounts.

admin.reports.title: Reports
admin.reports.description: Reports on providers, bookings and reviews.
